Credits.Body.GameDesign:
Philipp Brune

All core ideas, gameplay systems, rules design, roguelike structure,
and narrative vision are the original work of Philipp Brune.
Credits.Body.Programming:
Philipp Brune

Game logic, Unity systems, save architecture, economy systems,
puzzle generation, and all production code written by Philipp Brune,
with code suggestions assisted by AI tools (see AI Assistance).
Credits.Body.VisualArt:
Philipp Brune

All visual direction, palette design, pixel art specifications,
and UI layout conceived and directed by Philipp Brune.
Credits.Body.IconArt:
Concept icon art generated with the assistance of Fooocus
(open-source AI image generation).
All prompts, curation, and creative direction by Philipp Brune.
Runtime asset provenance is tracked in docs/legal/asset-provenance-register.md.
Credits.Body.MusicAudio:
Authored candidate music, SFX, and UI audio generated through
project-owned procedural synthesis. Composition structure, sound
design, and audio direction by Philipp Brune, with assistance from AI
tools (see AI Assistance). Runtime procedural fallback remains
available for development builds if an authored clip is missing.

MainMenu.Subtitle: Sudoku Roguelike
SudokuBasics.Step0.Title: Welcome to Sudoku
SudokuBasics.Step0.Body:
Fill every empty cell using the numbers 1 to {0}.
No number can appear twice in any row, column, or 2x3 box.
SudokuBasics.Step1.Title: The Row Rule
SudokuBasics.Step1.Body:
Every ROW must contain each number exactly once.
The highlighted row has some given numbers and some empty cells to fill.
SudokuBasics.Step2.Title: The Column Rule
SudokuBasics.Step2.Body:
Every COLUMN must also use each number exactly once.
The highlighted column has some numbers given and some still missing.
SudokuBasics.Step3.Title: The Box Rule
SudokuBasics.Step3.Body:
Every 2x3 BOX must contain all six numbers as well.
The highlighted box has 1, 3, 4, 5 - it still needs 2 and 6.
SudokuBasics.Step4.Title: Finding the Answer
SudokuBasics.Step4.Body:
We'll solve the highlighted cell.
Row 3 already has 5, 2, 3, 4 - so only 1 or 6 could go here.
SudokuBasics.Step5.Title: Narrow It Down
SudokuBasics.Step5.Body:
Column 1 already has 5, 3, 4, 1.
That eliminates 1 - and the row already ruled out 2, 3, 4.
Combining both, only ONE number is left...
SudokuBasics.Step6.Title: Only One Answer!
SudokuBasics.Step6.Body:
Row 3 rules out 2, 3, 4, 5.
Column 1 rules out 1, 3, 4, 5.
The only number that satisfies both rules is: 6
SudokuBasics.Step7.Title: Your Turn!
SudokuBasics.Step7.Body: Tap the highlighted cell, then press 6 on the numpad.
SudokuBasics.Step8.Title: Well Done!
SudokuBasics.Step8.Body:
Row 3 now has 5, 6, 2, 3, 4.
What's the only missing number for the last empty cell in row 3?
SudokuBasics.Step9.Title: One More!
SudokuBasics.Step9.Body:
Row 3 has 5, 6, 2, 3, 4 - only 1 is left.
Tap this cell and press 1.
SudokuBasics.Step10.Title: Pencil Marks
SudokuBasics.Step10.Body:
Sometimes two numbers could fit a cell at first glance.
Pencil marks let you note candidates so you can eliminate
wrong options step by step.
SudokuBasics.Step11.Title: Mark Your Candidates
SudokuBasics.Step11.Body:
Row 0 is missing 2 and 6 - either could fit here.
Pencil mode is now active. Press 2 then 6 to mark
both numbers as candidates.
SudokuBasics.Step12.Title: Eliminate With Logic
SudokuBasics.Step12.Body:
Column 1 already contains 6 - so 6 cannot go here!
The invalid candidate is crossed off. Only 2 remains.
SudokuBasics.Step13.Title: Commit the Answer
SudokuBasics.Step13.Body:
One pencil mark left - that's your answer!
Turn off pencil mode, tap this cell, and press 2.
SudokuBasics.Step14.Title: You've Got It!
SudokuBasics.Step14.Body:
Use rows, columns, boxes, and pencil marks to reason through every cell.
When only one number fits - that's your answer!

Finish solving the rest of the puzzle on your own.

GameModes.Description:
Garden Run: Full roguelike pathing, economy, and boss gates.

Endless Zen: Infinite 9x9 puzzle chain with HP attrition and no run rewards.

Spirit Trials: Single timed puzzle with tiered modifier pressure.

Daily Walk and Monthly Walk are focused objective modes.

SudokuBasicsPrompt.Body:
Before the first garden gate opens, would you like a short introduction to how Sudoku puzzles work?
(Takes about 2 minutes.)
FirstRun.Title: First-time setup
FirstRun.Body: Choose the language and accessibility defaults for this profile before entering the garden.
FirstRun.MoreOptionsHint: You can adjust text size, controls, audio, graphics, and gameplay options later from Options.
FirstRun.LegalBody: By continuing, you acknowledge the credits, third-party notices, trademark notices, AI-assistance disclaimer, and platform/privacy notices available from Credits.
Narrative.ClassIntro.NumberFreak: You count the sand-ridges before the gate finishes opening. Patterns answer when you pressure them gently.
Narrative.ClassIntro.GardenMonk: You set one palm on warm stone. The garden's breath steadies with yours.
Narrative.ClassIntro.ShrineArchivist: Scroll cases whisper beneath your sleeve. Every candidate mark feels like a recovered inscription.
Narrative.ClassIntro.KoiGambler: A gold koi breaks the surface as you pass. Risk follows you like a lucky ripple.
Narrative.ClassIntro.StoneGardener: Your chisel rests heavy at your belt. Broken paths can still be shaped into order.
Narrative.ClassIntro.LanternSeer: The lantern before you burns with a second shadow. Hidden rules show their edges early.
Narrative.ClassIntro.ReedDuelist: You step lightly, reed blade low. A clean solve is a vow, not a flourish.
Narrative.ClassIntro.QuietCartographer: Your map is blank where the garden is alive. You mark routes by listening before moving.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.NumberFrea: The final pattern leaves no remainder; even the bell seems to count you home.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.GardenMonk: The garden releases its breath with yours, and the last wound closes into quiet.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.ShrineArch: You bind the completed grid into memory; the archive has room for one more true route.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.KoiGambler: The koi turns gold beneath the torii. This time, the wager lands in your hand.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.StoneGarde: Stone, moss, and number settle into one shape. Nothing loose remains to mend.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.LanternSee: Every hidden rule burns clear in the lantern glass, and the summit lets you pass.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.ReedDuelis: Your final stroke is exact. The reeds bow without touching the water.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.QuietCarto: The living map completes itself behind you, one calm path at a time.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.NumberFreak: One count slipped from the pattern, but the unanswered digit stays in reach.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.GardenMonk: Your breath breaks before the gate, then returns; patience will carry you back.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.ShrineArchi: The archive closes on an unfinished page. Its margin waits for your next hand.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.KoiGambler: The gold koi dives before you can call the wager. Another ripple is already forming.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.StoneGarden: The path fractures under your step. You remember where the repair must begin.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.LanternSeer: The lantern clouds over, but one ember keeps the hidden rule warm.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.ReedDuelist: The reed bends instead of breaking. The vow can be taken again.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.QuietCartog: The map blurs at the edge of the garden. You still know where the first stone lies.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.0.0: Black moss threads through the raked sand.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.0.1: The cursed route promises a sharper blessing if you do not look away.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.1.0: A koi with clouded scales circles the pond edge.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.1.1: The water offers strength with a shadow tied to it.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.2.0: The bridge boards creak in a rhythm that does not match your steps.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.2.1: Crossing here means carrying the echo forward.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.3.0: One lantern burns with smoke instead of flame.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.3.1: Its curse will follow until the pattern is satisfied.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.4.0: A cracked torii charm turns cold in your hand.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.4.1: The summit accepts risk only when it is named.
RunEvent.quiet_bench.Title: A Quiet Bench
RunEvent.quiet_bench.Description: A weathered wooden bench sits in a sunny patch. You could sit for a moment.
RunEvent.quiet_bench.Option0.Label: Rest a while
RunEvent.quiet_bench.Option1.Label: Keep walking
RunEvent.ice_cream_cart.Title: Ice Cream Cart

RunEvent.ice_cream_cart.Option1.Label: Just browse

RunEvent.lost_wallet.Title: Lost Wallet
RunEvent.lost_wallet.Description: A worn leather wallet lies on the path. Someone's name is inside.
RunEvent.lost_wallet.Option0.Label: Return it honestly
RunEvent.lost_wallet.Option1.Label: Keep the cash
RunEvent.lost_wallet.Option2.Label: Leave it alone
RunEvent.wishing_fountain.Title: Wishing Fountain
RunEvent.wishing_fountain.Description: A small fountain glints with dropped coins. A sign reads: 'Wishes: 10g'.
RunEvent.wishing_fountain.Option0.Label: Toss a coin and wish
RunEvent.wishing_fountain.Option1.Label: Skip the fountain
RunEvent.friendly_stray.Title: Friendly Stray
RunEvent.friendly_stray.Description: A friendly stray trots up and drops something at your feet - an old item bag.
RunEvent.friendly_stray.Option0.Label: Take the bag
RunEvent.friendly_stray.Option1.Label: Offer a kind nod and leave
RunEvent.street_musician.Title: Street Musician
RunEvent.street_musician.Description: A busker plays a calm tune. A small crowd has gathered.
RunEvent.street_musician.Option0.Label: Tip generously (25g)
RunEvent.street_musician.Option1.Label: Listen for free
RunEvent.street_musician.Option2.Label: Walk past
RunEvent.maintenance_shed.Title: Maintenance Shed
RunEvent.maintenance_shed.Description: The park maintenance shed is unlocked and a window is open. Useful supplies inside.
RunEvent.maintenance_shed.Option0.Label: Borrow some supplies
RunEvent.maintenance_shed.Option1.Label: Leave it alone
RunEvent.ink_peddler.Title: The Ink Peddler
RunEvent.ink_peddler.Description: A shady vendor offers to swap your pencil reserves for a fat coin purse. The ink smells strange. He calls it a 'binding deal'.
RunEvent.ink_peddler.Option0.Label: Take the trade (gain Hollow Pencil curse)
RunEvent.ink_peddler.Option1.Label: Walk away
RunEvent.rare_flower_patch.Title: Rare Flower Patch
RunEvent.rare_flower_patch.Description: A cluster of unusual flowers blooms in a sheltered corner.
RunEvent.rare_flower_patch.Option0.Label: Pick one carefully
RunEvent.rare_flower_patch.Option1.Label: Leave them to grow
RunEvent.rare_flower_patch.Option2.Label: Take a sketch and move
RunEvent.tempting_shrine.Title: The Tempting Shrine
RunEvent.tempting_shrine.Description: A small stone shrine sits off the path. Moss-covered and old. Something about it feels like a bargain.
RunEvent.tempting_shrine.Option0.Label: Leave an offering and ask for strength (gain Weight of Stone curse)
RunEvent.tempting_shrine.Option1.Label: Just look and leave
